title: Design System: Cybersecurity Club at NMSU

label.purpose: Small technical labels in Fira Code (0.75rem, 600, 0.06em tracking), used sparingly.

motion.name: smooth-scroll
motion.purpose: Document scrolling; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

docsArticle.tokens: site variables only; no separate colour set
docsArticle.purpose: Article layout for code blocks, callouts and file trees; reuses --surface, --line, --muted, --ink, --volt, --ice and the callout colours.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:48px; padding:11px 20px; border:1px solid #27b7eb; border-radius:5px; background:#27b7eb; color:#000000; font:800 17px/1.6 Figtree, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; } .ds-button:hover { background:#94cdf0; border-color:#94cdf0; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #27b7eb; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:48px; padding:11px 20px; border:1px solid #626775; border-radius:5px; background:transparent; color:#f4f1f4; font:800 17px/1.6 Figtree, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; } .ds-secondary:hover { background:#202530; border-color:#94cdf0; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #27b7eb; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Desktop navigation with an active underline; mobile navigation uses a native disclosure.
components.html: EventsActivities
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:2px 4px; font-family:Figtree,sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color:#bec0cb; padding:10px 11px; border-radius:5px; font-size:.88rem; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav a:hover,.ds-nav a[aria-current=page] { background:#202530; color:#f4f1f4; } .ds-nav a[aria-current=page] { box-shadow:inset 0 -2px #27b7eb; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #27b7eb; outline-offset:4px; }

components.html:

narrative.overview: The site is dark-only, direct, and welcoming. Real club activities and clear paths to participation carry the personality; the supplied roadrunner artwork anchors the identity without a backing panel.
keyCharacteristics: Dark surfaces with legible light text and understated borders.
Figtree for interface and headings, Crimson Text for introductions, and Fira Code for limited technical labels.
Volt actions and focus rings with Ice links; club artwork keeps its original colors and proportions.
Real club activity and clearly labeled uncertainty take precedence over invented proof.
dos: Do preserve the supplied club artwork and its original proportions.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and readable contrast on dark surfaces.
Do label historical or unverified information and link to its source.
Do keep the mobile menu and its links keyboard-accessible, and allow actions to wrap at small widths.
Do keep motion to a few deliberate moments, and honor reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't add a light theme without a new design decision.
Don't invent sponsors, members, or meeting dates.
Don't treat the draft brand guide as finalized policy.
